themes.title: Far-right parties push 'national priority' policies
themes.blurb: Right-wing and far-right parties across Europe are intensifying efforts to implement 'national priority' policies, which prioritize citizens over immigrants in social benefits, housing, and public services. This theme is particularly strong in Spain, Italy, and Sweden, with parallel legislative efforts and public debates.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna
countries.note: SD proposes stricter language rules for teachers and prioritizes Swedish citizens in welfare policies.

countries.name: 🇫🇷 Rassemblement National

countries.name: 🇳🇴 Fremskrittspartiet
countries.note: FrP advocates for stricter immigration policies, including cuts to benefits for non-citizens.

themes.title: Trump’s policies dominate global right-wing coverage
themes.blurb: Donald Trump's domestic and foreign policies continue to shape right-wing narratives worldwide, with his influence extending to Poland, Argentina, Italy, and the UK. Coverage focuses on his endorsements, policy decisions, and the broader MAGA movement's impact on global conservative politics.

themes.title: Rise of far-right parties in European polls
themes.blurb: Far-right parties across Europe are gaining significant traction in polls, with the AfD in Germany, Sverigedemokraterna in Sweden, and Vox in Spain leading the surge. This trend reflects growing voter dissatisfaction with mainstream parties and a shift toward nationalist, anti-immigration platforms.

countries.note: AfD leads German polls with 28-29%, surpassing traditional parties like CDU/CSU and SPD.

countries.name: 🇸🇪 Sverigedemokraterna

countries.note: RN leads French polls, with Jordan Bardella positioning himself as a key figure in the 2027 presidential election.

countries.name: 🇪🇸 Vox
countries.note: Vox gains ground in Spain, particularly in Andalusia and Valencia, influencing regional governments.
